name: Arts & Culture Commission Liaison Committee Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Arts & Culture Commission Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON / TELEPHONIC / VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Meeting
  https://beverlyhills-org.zoom.us/my/committee

  Monday, December 4, 2023
  5:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  December 4, 2023 / 5:01 p.m.

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian A. Gold; Councilmember Lili Bosse; Nancy Hunt Coffey, City
  Manager; Stephanie Harris, Director of Community Services; Patty Acuna,
  Assistant Director of Community Services; Commissioner Deborah Frank;
  Commissioner Pamela Beck; Joana Torres, Community Services
  Manager; Paul Paolone, interim Recreation Manager; Brandy Scott, Arts &
  Culture Program Associate; Linda Kyriazi, Management Assistant.
  On Zoom: Robert Van Veer, Executive Director, The Wallis

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.
  None.

  2) Recommendation by the Arts and Culture Commission on a new proposed
  installation site for the Acquisition & Installation of the Artwork Trinity by Judy
  Chicago.
  Stephanie Harris, Director of Community Services, provided a recap to the Council
  Liaisons on the proposed acquisition and installation sites that were recommended from
  the Arts and Culture Commission.
  - The artist, along with the gallery, no longer supported placement at Beverly Gardens
  Park as the installation site, due to various concerns.
  - The new proposed site is the corner of the Wallis property on South Santa Monica
  Boulevard and Crescent Drive.
  - Arts and Culture Commission Ad Hoc and the Gallery believe this new proposed site
  location will provide an ideal backdrop and protective barrier. This location is also
  considered ideal by the Arts and Culture Commission.
  - The 10-year requested warranty was secured from the fabricator, Ironwood.
   -  Previously, the anticipated “all-in” cost of the acquisition of Trinity by Judy Chicago
  was presented at $550,000 to account for the purchase of the artwork, transportation,
  design and fabrication of the preferred anchoring system. With the additional site
  treatments required, the ancillary costs may exceed the original request for $150,000.
  This will bring the overall acquisition and installation to a not-to-exceed cost of
  $650,000.

  The funding for acquisition of the artwork is available in the Fine Art Fund, a restricted fund
  that can only be used for fine art related expenses.

  After detailed discussions of the installation costs, location along with landscaping and
  lighting, security, in addition to the warranty for the art piece, City Council Liaisons support
  the item coming before the full City Council once the outstanding items are finalized and
  complete renderings are available.

  3) Adjournment
  Date / Time:  December 4, 2023 / 5:49 p.m.

Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable
